notablePrerequisites: Apprentice Necromancer and Alloy Myr do not have summoning sickness.
description:
Activate Alloy Myr by tapping it, adding {B}.
Activate Teardrop Kami by sacrificing it, targeting Alloy Myr.
Ashnod triggers, copying Teardrop Kami's ability, targeting Alloy Myr.
Resolve the first Teardrop Kami trigger, untapping Alloy Myr.
Activate Alloy Myr by tapping it, adding {B}.
Resolve the second Teardrop Kami trigger, untapping Alloy Myr.
Activate Apprentice Necromancer by paying {B}, tapping and sacrificing it, targeting Teardrop Kami.
Ashnod triggers, copying Apprentice Necromancer's ability, targeting Apprentice Necromancer.
Resolve both Apprentice Necromancer abilities, returning Apprentice Necromancer and Teardrop Kami from your graveyard to the battlefield, and giving them haste until end of turn.
Repeat.
